run_pipeline_flux_rf_inversion_invert: run RF inversion on an image to produce inverted latents for subsequent editing
run_pipeline_flux_rf_inversion_call: run controlled reverse ODE denoising loop to edit an image using inverted latents and a new prompt
calculate_shift_scheduler_parameter: calculate the shift parameter for the FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler based on image sequence length
encode_image_to_latents: encode an input image into VAE latent space with optional height and width resizing
encode_prompt_embeddings: encode text prompts into CLIP pooled embeddings and T5 text embeddings for the Flux transformer
